column1: # Expanded-goal requirement 10: adversarial authority containment over the deployed public surface.
# Columns: role, authentication model, production routes, maximum correctly authorized effect,
# forbidden unrelated effect, authentication evidence, economic-containment evidence.
# Route lists are comma-separated. Evidence lists are semicolon-separated path#test references.

column4: May serialize bounded market policies, resolve or shut down lifecycle state, rotate the market key, exchange equal base units, and perform terminal or shutdown cleanup only after the production stock and claim gates pass.
column5: Cannot debit a live portfolio, seize a foreign asset role, redirect an existing user claim, or sweep custody while user capital or claims remain.

column4: May rotate empty scope-local roles, burn only its own cold-admin role, and move its bound asset through validated lifecycle transitions.
column5: Cannot seize a funded operator role, mutate another asset, erase an active claim, or remove the permissionless economic exit for the bound asset.

column4: May select authenticated oracle configuration and raw targets for one asset, but deployed effective-price movement, funding checkpoints, fees, lifecycle admission, and observation sequencing bound the committed economic effect.
column5: Cannot transfer tokens directly, mutate another asset, bypass the elapsed-time mark envelope, make unpaid mark movement withdrawable, or eliminate every owner exit or terminal fallback.

column4: May add its own quote atoms, set bounded fee policy through the configured insurance authority, reconcile telemetry, and withdraw no more than the independently computed current asset budget after live or terminal gates.
column5: Cannot debit portfolio principal, consume another asset budget, turn telemetry into value, reduce junior residual backing, or withdraw protected insurance while unresolved user obligations require it.

column4: May add its own provider principal, withdraw only fresh unencumbered principal or realized earnings in its domain, and reconcile its non-value telemetry.
column5: Cannot withdraw liened or impaired backing, insurance, portfolio principal, another domain's stock, or any value not attributed to the provider ledger.

column4: May return a fill only for the current LP capability and request, within the taker's signed quantity, price, aggregate slippage, fee, asset, generation, and episode envelope.
column5: Cannot forge request identity, overfill, reverse direction, charge unsigned LP fees, spend aged senior collateral, replay return data, or mutate protocol accounts outside the validated fill.

column4: May sign only the exact CPI to the LP-configured matcher program and context for the current portfolio capability; it has no standalone economic instruction.
column5: Cannot forward the taker signer, carry writable Percolator state in the matcher tail, substitute another context, or authorize a token or lamport debit outside the fill contract.

column4: May choose accounts, authenticated observation availability, timing, and bounded work hints; current on-chain state selects or caps the action, amount, rank transition, payout destination, fee, and configured reward.
column5: Cannot make a hint or stale scalar economic truth, choose an unbounded liquidation or payout, divert owner value, collect reward ahead of senior obligations, or prevent a later honest bounded continuation.
